title: Synthetic fixture and discovery for Antigravity conversations and summaries DB
description: Fixture mirrors ~/.gemini/antigravity and antigravity-cli (conversations dir plus conversation_summaries.db). Done when: discovery finds conversations from both roots.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Synthetic Antigravity fixture + BDD: conversation_summaries.db drives conversation discovery (3 conversations -> 3 sessions); brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl preferred with per-conversation payload.db fallback for linkage. AntigravitySource::new(root) + discover()/doctor() in src/adapters/antigravity.rs; fixture steps in tests/steps/antigravity_steps.rs. Full gate green (bdd 114/114).

right_now_summary: The team is building a fixture to discover Antigravity conversations from both roots.
